articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring natively fused vision, audio, and text reasoning in a single architecture rather than stitched-together modules. The model demonstrates significant gains on ARC-AGI-2 benchmarks and supports a 1M-token effective context window, marking a meaningful step toward general-purpose autonomous agents.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Reasoning Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which tops GPQA Diamond and MATH-500 leaderboards while introducing a new chain-of-thought verification layer that reduces hallucination rates by roughly 40%. The model also integrates real-time tool use, allowing it to execute code, query APIs, and browse the web within a single reasoning trace.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI's second-generation humanoid robot, Figure 02, has entered full-shift commercial deployment on BMW's assembly line in South Carolina, handling bin-picking, part inspection, and material transport tasks. The deployment represents one of the first scaled commercial uses of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing, operating alongside human workers across two shifts.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster-Site Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased the all-electric Atlas performing autonomous search-and-rescue navigation through a collapsed structure mockup, combining real-time LiDAR SLAM with a vision-language model for semantic scene understanding. The robot completed multi-floor traversal including ladder climbing and debris manipulation without human teleoperation, a significant milestone for field-deployable humanoid robotics.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Real-Time Enterprise AI Safety Monitoring
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise product that uses lightweight constitutional AI classifiers running in parallel with production LLM deployments to flag policy violations, data leakage, and prompt injection attacks in real time. The system operates at sub-10ms latency overhead and is already integrated into Claude's enterprise API tier, giving security teams auditable traces of all flagged interactions.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N2 process using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab, roughly one quarter ahead of the original timeline. The node delivers an estimated 25% speed improvement or 30% power reduction over N3E, with Apple and Nvidia reportedly among the first customers receiving wafers.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions, requesting technical documentation and systemic risk assessments from major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta. This marks the transition from regulatory framework to active enforcement, with potential fines of up to 3% of global annual revenue for non-compliance.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 2T Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates roughly 400B parameters per forward pass, under a permissive license allowing commercial use. Benchmarks show it competing with GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Ultra on reasoning tasks while being runnable on a single 8×H200 node, making frontier-class capabilities accessible to the open-source community.
